name: E2E-SEED-005 — 非女装商品MetaQ入口不触发种草图文
description: 验证非女装类目(如男装/童装)F0商品通过MetaQ入口时，SeedClothingCategoryFilter.isClothingItemForSeed返回false，不触发triggerSeedGenerate。共用一次类目查询结果，图文视频同时过滤。
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草链路

steps.description: [造数] 导航到商品管理页(获取cobweb API域+cookie)
[造数] 将非女装测试商品(男装sellerId=2219635649153)设为F0
[造数] 验证分层修改API调用成功

steps.expression: (() => { return { testType: 'clothing-filter-metaq', scenario: '非女装MetaQ过滤', filter: 'SeedClothingCategoryFilter', method: 'isClothingItemForSeed', switch: 'SEED_CLOTHING_LEVEL1_CATE_IDS', defaultAllowed: [16], testItems: [ { name: '男装商品', sellerId: '2219635649153', expectedLevel1Cate: '男装', expectedLevel1Id: 30, allowed: false }, { name: '童装商品', sellerId: 'non-clothing', expectedLevel1Cate: '童装', expectedLevel1Id: 50010728, allowed: false }, { name: '女装商品', sellerId: '2219662018344', expectedLevel1Cate: '女装/女士精品', expectedLevel1Id: 16, allowed: true } ], behavior: { nonClothingF0: 'isClothingItemForSeed→false→不触发triggerSeedGenerate+triggerSeedVideoGenerate', clothingF0: 'isClothingItemForSeed→true→正常触发双链路', sharedQuery: '一次查询结果同时用于图文和视频判定', exceptionSafe: '类目查询异常/null/空→保守返回false(不触发)' } }; })()

(() => { const s = ${nonClothingMetaqSpec}; return { validation: '非女装MetaQ过滤规则', checks: [ { name: '男装F0不触发', expected: 'isClothingItemForSeed=false', rule: 'cate_level1_id=30 ≠ 16', pass: true }, { name: '童装F0不触发', expected: 'isClothingItemForSeed=false', rule: 'cate_level1_id=50010728 ≠ 16', pass: true }, { name: '女装F0正常触发', expected: 'isClothingItemForSeed=true', rule: 'cate_level1_id=16 ∈ allowedLevel1s', pass: true }, { name: '图文视频共享判定', expected: '一次查询同时过滤双链路', rule: 'isClothingItemForSeed结果复用', pass: true }, { name: '异常保守策略', expected: 'null/空/异常→false', rule: 'SeedClothingCategoryFilter.isClothingItem null-safe', pass: true }, { name: 'F1/F2降级不过滤', expected: '降级不做类目判断', rule: 'handleTierDowngrade直接取消,不走isClothingItemForSeed', pass: true } ] }; })()

steps.description: 截图 - 非女装MetaQ过滤验证

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发环境MQ可用；SEED_CLOTHING_LEVEL1_CATE_IDS=[16]；存在非女装F0测试商品(男装sellerId=2219635649153)
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.对非女装F0商品触发TIER_TAG_CHANGED消息 2.消费端查询F层级=F0 3.isClothingItemForSeed查询类目→cate_level1_id≠16→返回false 4.不触发triggerSeedGenerate和triggerSeedVideoGenerate 5.验证无PENDING记录落库
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①非女装F0商品不触发种草图文 ②不触发种草视频 ③ai_process_record无新记录 ④日志输出'非女装F0商品剔除'
_testDesign.dbAssertion: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_process_record WHERE item_id=<非女装itemId> AND gmt_create > T0 AND processMode='seedGenerate' = 0
riskPoints: 类目查询超时会导致消息重试，需关注重试次数
类目服务异常时保守返回false，可能误过滤女装商品
SEED_CLOTHING_LEVEL1_CATE_IDS被误清空会导致全量过滤
